name: OpenSOSData
description: Search US business entity records across all 53 jurisdictions (50 states + DC + PR + USVI) in real time. KYB verification, entity status checks, UCC lien searches, name availability, and batch lookups from official Secretary of State portals.

tools.name: search_business_entity
tools.description: Search for a US business entity by name in a specific state or territory. Returns entity name, ID, status, type, registered agent, and address. Covers all 53 US jurisdictions including DC, Puerto Rico, and US Virgin Islands.

tools.name: check_entity_status
tools.description: Verify if a business entity is active, inactive, or dissolved in a specific US jurisdiction. Ideal for KYB compliance, due diligence, and vendor verification workflows.

tools.name: batch_search
tools.description: Search for multiple business entities simultaneously across different states. Maximum 10 entities per batch. Returns results for each entity in order.

tools.name: list_supported_jurisdictions
tools.description: Returns all 53 US jurisdictions with live business entity search coverage, including all 50 states, Washington DC, Puerto Rico, and US Virgin Islands.

tools.name: get_jurisdictions_for_region
tools.description: Get the list of US jurisdictions in a specific region. Useful for multi-state compliance checks and understanding regional coverage.

tools.name: search_ucc_filings
tools.description: Search UCC (Uniform Commercial Code) lien filings by debtor name in a specific US state. Returns filing number, status, debtor and secured party details, filing and lapse dates, and collateral description.

tools.name: check_name_availability
tools.description: Check whether a business name is available to register in a US state or territory. Returns availability status plus conflicting entity matches.

tools.name: create_agent_account
tools.description: Create a new OpenSOSData agent account. Returns an API key (shown once). Pay-first account — fund via top_up_wallet before lookups.

tools.name: top_up_wallet
tools.description: Initiates a real payment to add wallet credit to an OpenSOSData agent account. Tiers: starter ($50), growth ($100), scale ($250), enterprise ($500).

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check the current wallet balance and remaining lookup count for the authenticated OpenSOSData account.
